original: dāyabhāgābhidhānaṃ ca tat syād viṃśatimaṃ padam||
analyzed: dāya bhāga abhidhānam ca tat syāt viṃśatimam padam

original: ekaviṃśaṃ tathā dyūtaṃ dvāviśaṃ tu samāhvayam|
analyzed: ekaviṃśam tathā dyūtam dvāviśam tu samāhvayam
vyavahāra padāni etāni āha someśvaraḥ nṛpaḥ
iti vyavahāra padāni
svayam na utpādayet kāryam samarthaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
na ādadīta tathā utkocam dattam kārya arthinā nṛpaḥ
vivādāya āgatam pṛcchet sabhāyām puratas sthitam

original: kiṃ kāryaṃ kiṃ ca duḥkhaṃ te tyaktaśaṅko nivedaya||
analyzed: kim kāryam kim ca duḥkham te tyakta śaṅkaḥ nivedaya

original: nirūpite punaḥ pṛcchet kena kasmin kutaḥ katham|
analyzed: nirūpite punar pṛcchet kena kasmin kutas katham

original: tasmāt tava kṛtaṃ brūhi satyameva sabhāgataḥ||
analyzed: tasmāt tava kṛtam brūhi satyam eva sabhā gataḥ

original: sabhyaiḥ saha samālocya padaṃ nyāyyaṃ yathā bhavet|
analyzed: sabhyaiḥ saha samālocya padam nyāyyam yathā bhavet
pratyarthinaḥ tathā hvānam lekhaiḥ dūtaiḥ ca kārayet
āhūtaḥ yadi na āgacchet vyādhitaḥ duḥkhitaḥ
niruddhaḥ viṣama sthaḥ vā kriyā vyagraḥ jvaran api
svāmi kārya pradaḥ vā pi nṛpa kārya rataḥ

original: matto vā 'tha pramatto vā tathāpyeṣa na duṣyati||
analyzed: mattaḥ vā pramattaḥ vā tathā api eṣa na duṣyati
kulīnā para bhāryā ca yuvatiḥ ca prasūtikā
rajasvalā pakṣa hīnā na āhvātavyā sabhām prati
arthi pratyarthi vākyāni lekhayitvā vicārayet
deśa kāla anusāreṇa hetubhiḥ ca pṛthagvidhaiḥ
likhitāt sākṣitaḥ bhukteḥ pramāṇa tritayāt atas
vicārayet mahīpālaḥ smṛti śāstra anusārataḥ
etaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ hīnasya divyam deyam mahībhujā
tat ca deyam vayaḥ vasthāḥ deśa kāla anusārataḥ
pramāṇam mānuṣam yatra durlabha tvena varttate

original: tadā divyaṃ pradeyaṃ syānna deyaṃ mānuṣe sati||
analyzed: tadā divyam pradeyam syāt na deyam mānuṣe sati
śaṅkitānām narendreṇa kathitānām ca taskaraiḥ

original: śuddhimanvicchatāṃ tasya divyaṃ deyaṃ vinā śiraḥ||
analyzed: śuddhim anvicchatām tasya divyam deyam vinā śiraḥ
pramāṇaiḥ niścite vā pi divyaiḥ vā pi vicārite
yuktyā daṇḍam nṛpaḥ kuryāt yathā doṣa anusārataḥ
viṣa ikṣu danti bhujaga śāstra anala jala ādibhiḥ
pāpānām prāṇa haraṇam vadha daṇḍaḥ prakirttitaḥ
keśānām karṇayoḥ akṣṇoḥ nāsikāyāḥ tathā eva ca
jihvāyāḥ karayoḥ tadvat aṅgulī prajanasya ca
pādayoḥ evamādīnām aṅgānām chedanam ca yat
aparādha anusāreṇa kleśa daṇḍaḥ saḥ ucyate

original: bandhanaṃ tāḍanaṃ vācā rūkṣayā bhartsanaṃ tathā|
analyzed: bandhanam tāḍanam vācā rūkṣayā bhartsanam tathā
evaṃvidha prakāraḥ pi kleśadaṇḍaḥ prakīrttitaḥ
paṇānām śate sarddhe prathamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasraṃ caiva cottamaḥ||
analyzed: madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasram ca eva ca uttamaḥ

original: vivādena samaḥ kvāpi diguṇaḥ kvāpi kathyate|
analyzed: vivādena samaḥ kvāpi diguṇaḥ kvāpi kathyate
triguṇaḥ vā kvacid proktaḥ kvacid uktaḥ caturguṇaḥ
sarva svasya adhikaḥ kvāpi damaḥ sava svam eva vā
doṣa dravya anusāreṇa smṛtaḥ

original: daṇḍo rakṣati maryādāṃ daṇḍo dharmaṃ pravarttayet|
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ rakṣati maryādām daṇḍaḥ dharmam pravarttayet
nivārayet adharmāt ca tasmāt daṇḍam prayojayet

original: daṇḍahīne yato rāṣṭre mātsyo nyāyaḥ pravartate|
analyzed: daṇḍa hīne yatas rāṣṭre mātsyaḥ nyāyaḥ pravartate

original: tasmād daṇḍaṃ prayuñjīta duṣṭānāṃ dhārmiko nṛpaḥ||
analyzed: tasmāt daṇḍam prayuñjīta duṣṭānām dhārmikaḥ nṛpaḥ
daṇḍa pāta bhayāt lokaḥ dharme tiṣṭhati sūtritaḥ
karī iva vijayaḥ pi aṅkuśena vaśīkṛtaḥ
tīvra daṇḍa bhayāt loke bhṛśam udvijite janaḥ
tasmāt mṛdu prayogeṇa prajā pālanam ācaret
yathā ukta daṇḍa vinyāsāt bhūpateḥ dharma cāriṇaḥ
yaśaḥ dharmaḥ tathā rāṣṭram kośaḥ ca parivardhate
evam aṅgāni rājyasya sapta śakti trayam tathā
ṣāḍguṇyam ca tathā proktam upāyaḥ ca caturvidhaḥ
rājya sthairya nimittāni prāpta rājyasya bhūpateḥ
viṃśatiḥ soma bhūpālaḥ kṛtavān nīti kovidaḥ
iti daṇḍa adhyāyaḥ
iti mahā rāja adhirāja satya āśraya kula tilaka cālukya ābharaṇa
śrīmat bhū loka malla śrī someśvaradeva viracite
mānasollāse bhilasṣita artha cintāmaṇau rājya sthirīkaraṇa upāya kathane
dvitīyam prakaraṇam
prathamaḥ bhāgaḥ samāptaḥ
